noticed_not_touched.what: Output of a short-lived process can be missing from the ring after exit under heavy load: the pre-existing test a_program_runs_directly_with_its_title_and_reports_its_exit_code failed once in five full-suite runs on its `plain_text(&pty.output_since(0)).contains("hi there")` assertion, with the exit code reported correctly. The likely cause, not proven, is unread slave-to-master output being dropped when the child closes the last slave fd before the reader thread drains it (the parent drops pair.slave right after spawn). pty_tail after exit depends on this, so a fast Run command could reach the agent (T7) with an empty or short output. A fix would keep a slave fd in the parent until the child is reaped, then drain and drop it; it changes every tab's lifecycle.

A process killed by a signal is reported as code 1, never None: pty.rs maps child.wait() with exit_code(), and portable-pty 0.9.0 (src/lib.rs:214-226) builds a signal status with code 1. So PtyEvent::Exit, OpenSpec.on_exit and panel://pty-exit never carry `code: None` for a signal, despite their docs and spec 4.4 ("a signal -> ended by a signal"); the plan's wire contract `exitCode: null = ended by a signal` will not be produced for Run tabs. Read from the source, not observed at runtime.

behavior_changes.description: pty_open_command refuses an empty or whitespace-only command with "Nothing to run: the command is empty" and a command holding a NUL with "The command contains a NUL character"; the wording is mine. The Run buttons only offer a single non-empty command line, so these strings reach a user only through a caller that passes such a command.
alternatives: Reuse open_run_tab's "Nothing to run" for both cases

notes: TDD order: the 6 first tests were written and run red (E0599/E0425: open_command, tail and TAIL_MAX_LINES missing), then pty.rs was implemented and they went green; the Tauri commands, registration and TS wrappers followed. One first-version test used a freshly written fake-shell script to print its argv; it timed out under full-suite load for the same reason as the shellenv/appupdate tests, so it was replaced by two tests: /bin/echo as the user's shell (prints exactly `-l -i -c <command>`) and /bin/sh printing TERM, SHELL, a login-env variable and pwd. Those two were written after the implementation and were not observed red. New tests set HOME to the temp dir and drop ENV/BASH_ENV/ZDOTDIR so the developer's rc files never run; they wait on the on_exit channel, never a sleep. Every new test name contains run_command. pty_tail reads at most the 1 MiB ring, as terminal_read already does. Not verified: the Tauri commands over real IPC in a running app (no app run), the panel://pty-exit emit for a command tab at runtime (it is the same announce_exit hook pty_open_run uses, no test drives AppHandle), and zsh as the login shell (tests use /bin/sh and /bin/echo; an earlier manual probe of `zsh -l -i -c` under a pty printed only the command's output). Build prerequisites created in gitignored paths and left in place for later cargo runs in this worktree: apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/keryx-aarch64-apple-darwin (a stub sidecar like CI's) and an empty apps/desktop/dist/. No project-skill routes to apps/desktop/src-tauri (keryx skills route gave only generic token matches); no skill was relied on. Parallel lane T6's files (src/acp/**, src/commands/agent.ts) were not read, touched or staged.
